name: Napoleon Hill Signature
description: Inferred left-to-right cursive traversal for the Napoleon Hill autograph mapped to U+E000. Reconstructed along the ink skeleton of napHillHW5.jpg: continuous left-to-right cursive across 'Napoleon' into the left stem of 'H', lifting inside 'H' to the tall spire through 'i-l-l', lifting for the detached 'i' dot, and lifting for the terminal dash. Not recorded historical pen telemetry.
